## Description

Prove the phase exit criteria hold together through the real test entry points.

## Approach

Run the four exit-criterion commands from the phase body. The integration entry point is `tests/test_evidence_loop.py`, which drives `adaptive-artifacts` on a fresh store. Then run the contract self-consistency test, the skill-contract and routing tests named in the phase body, and `tests/test_readme_lifecycle.py`.

Do not change production code to make a failure pass. If a command fails, report the failure and leave the phase short of done.
record.subject: verify-evidence-loop
